beforeBlock: if (!mapped) return books().availability(ref.book, ref.page) === 'unverified' ? empty(`Printed p. ${ref.page} cannot be mapped reliably in the provided ${ref.book} scan; its identity is unverified.`, 'Source page unverified — no substitute page is shown.') : empty(books().missingPageNotice(ref.book, ref.page), 'Known source gap — no substitute page is shown.');
scope: Only the accepted-supplemental-image PDF-mode notice branch changes. Current runtime continuation checks continue to execute the actual complete viewer; this exact reversal preserves the earlier whole-viewer proof.
